$comment: Desktop compatibility sweep round 5: the next 30 Chrome Web Store extensions by install count after the top 30 of round 1, the 30 of next30.json, the 30 of next30-round3.json and the 30 of next30-round4.json (ranks 121-150; the harness at /tmp/zen-compat reads this list; manifests under the project store internal/extensions/next30-round5/). Counts are the store detail pages' rounded figures read 2026-09-21; ties inside one rounded bucket are ordered by the page's rating count (equal counts by name). Candidates came from the store's category listings and keyword searches, about 10,800 detail pages probed across rounds 3 to 5 (vidIQ and Web PKI, 4M each, surfaced in this round's probe, not in rounds 3 and 4's). Not ranked: themes, Chrome Apps (Google Classroom), organisation-login-only items (Endpoint Verification, ClassLink OneClick, Clever, Mobility Print, Lightspeed Insight Agent, Okta Browser Plugin, Trellix Endpoint Security Web Control, LearnPlatform for Students, OpenText Content Server Browser Web Extension, My Apps Secure Sign-in Extension, MasteryConnect LockDown Browser, HID Credential Management Extension) and Google items whose detail pages publish no user count (Office Editing for Docs, Sheets & Slides and the Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, YouTube and Gmail shortcuts). The rounded 2,000,000 bucket held 28 rankable items for 25 places; the rating-count tie-break leaves out The QR Code Generator (501 ratings), Cookie-Editor (410) and Browsing Protection by WithSecure (11).
